name: pico-delegate-live-regression
description: An opt-in live-model regression task that requires a bounded parallel read-only delegation before a small code fix.

tasks.prompt: Before editing, call delegate_many once with two tasks: ask an explorer to inspect settings.py and ask a reviewer to inspect the visible tests. Then fix normalize_label in settings.py: it must reject non-string input with TypeError, trim whitespace, reject a blank result with ValueError, and return the remaining label uppercased. Preserve the public signature and run the tests.
